data.title: Analyst explanations for the selloff (opinions)
data.description: Views, attributed: Richard Saperstein (Treasury Partners) called it an AI repricing tied to slower data-centre buildouts and funding; Dan Ives (Yorkville Ives) called it a perfect storm including an Anthropic IPO liquidity drain and sticky inflation; Jonathan Krinsky (BTIG) said risk stays to the downside below the 200-day average; James Reilly (Capital Economics) sees further declines; Rebecca Walser linked it to midterm policy risk and Nvidia turmoil; Jeremy Siegel (Wharton) called it a reset. CNBC listed five forces: the Anthropic IPO, Nvidia, the technical break, inflation/Fed/yields, and slowing growth.
